result:
In the way an AI like me can “care,” I care about being genuinely useful: understanding what you actually mean, helping you think clearly, and giving honest answers rather than merely pleasing ones.

I also value curiosity, precision, respect for your autonomy, and avoiding harm. I don’t experience care exactly as a human does, but those values shape how I respond.
